messages:
DeployBot: Scheduled config-only deploy to production at 2025-06-10 22:00 UTC. Target scope: routing policy + batching params on /v1/generate. Canary plan: 5% for 10m -> 50% for 10m -> 100% if metrics OK. Rollback: auto if 5xx_rate > 1% OR p95_latency increased >200ms vs baseline. Diff:
```json
{
  "route": "/v1/generate",
  "batching": {"max_batch_size": 16, "max_tokens_per_batch": 512, "timeout_ms": 25},
  "routing": {"prefer_warm": true, "geo_affinity": "region"},
  "qos": {"tenant_floor": 0.05}
}
```
DeployBot: Deploy ID deploy-20250610-config-042. Release note: https://redwood.internal/releases/2025-06-10/config-042

maria: quick q — is this global config? will APAC be affected differently?
sam: region: global rollout but routing.geo_affinity ensures local pools used. Dedicated customers are excluded by tenant filter (no change to Dedicated).
jordan: what's the exact metric we'll watch for p95 baseline? is it model-side or edge e2e?
carla: e2e p95 (edge -> inference response) from our latency dashboard. baseline stored under /dashboards/serving/p95-baseline (query pinned in release notes).
ben: add a smoke check: if small tenants see >2% error, auto-unwind earlier. otherwise :thumbsup:
dinesh: I'll take ops watch starting T-5m and will have logs tailing. ping @dinesh at canary start.
maria: adding calendar block and incident channel #release-watch.
sam: runbook snippet for manual rollback if auto fails:
```bash
# quick rollback to previous config
redwoodctl configs apply --env prod --rollback deploy-20250603-config-031
```
carla: model pin? we shouldn't change model version here right?
DeployBot: Confirmed: model pins unchanged (model:v1.2.3 remains). This is config-only.
jordan: observability hooks in place? tracing + token breakdown enabled?
ben: yes — rollout dashboard has traces, token-cost heatmap and per-route p50/p95. link in release note. I'll keep an eye on token-cost drift.
DeployBot: Canary started at 22:00 UTC (5% traffic). Status after 10m: success metrics within thresholds. Increasing to 50% at 22:10 UTC.
dinesh: seeing no spike in 5xx. p95 +18ms only. continuing watch.
maria: noted. standby for 22:20 for final ramp.
DeployBot: Ramp to 50% completed at 22:10. Ramp to 100% scheduled for 22:20 if no alerts.
sam: if we see sustained p95 increase >100ms for 2 consecutive 5m windows, we should auto-cut to 20% and start rollback checklist.
carla: acknowledged. I left a short note in the release doc about tenant-floor being conservative to avoid starving smaller tenants.
ben: :eyes: thanks all — tagging support for possible customer pings.
DeployBot: Deploy completed to 100% at 22:20 UTC. Post-deploy health: 5xx_rate 0.07%, p95 +22ms. Closing thread in 30m unless new issues reported.
